meta.title: Operation TRYZUB — COA Analysis (Step 4)
meta.classification: NATO UNCLASSIFIED // FOR TRAINING USE ONLY

phases.d: Guard the first line; BRC II covering force screens BHL–PL1 and passes rearward. End: enemy main body crosses the BHL and is forced to deploy early.
BAIDA fixes the enemy in EA1; DOVBUSH delays to PL YELLOW; KOZHUMIAKA O/O CATK. End: enemy fixed in EA1.
KOZHUMIAKA CATK to neutralise the enemy in EA1; BAIDA blocks the northern flank. End: enemy 2nd-line brigades move to PL YELLOW.
Contain IVO PL3; XII ARMD BDE CATK from the SOUTH and rearward passage. End: XII ARMD BDE crosses PL PURPLE.
Feints IVO EA2/EA3 and withdrawal to PL4. End: brigade anchored on PL4, obstacle and fire plan complete.
Block at PL4, canalise to EA4/EA5; withdraw behind PL GREEN able to fight a further step.
KOZHUMIAKA CATK in EA7; KOTYHOROSHKO consolidates; FPOL corridors open for the OSG striking force.

hhq.order: OTG "MAMAI" OPORD — Operation TRYZUB (OSG "HETMAN" main effort). X ASSAULT BDE "SIRKO" is the OTG main effort.
hhq.purpose: As the OSG main effort, canalise the enemy centre of gravity (14th Armoured Division) into EA "HETMAN" so the striking force can deliver the decisive counterattack. Trade space for time between PL1 and PL4, breaking the tempo of 13th Mech Division and forcing the premature commitment of its follow-on echelons.
hhq.key: Precise synchronisation of the retrograde — clean breaks, no decisive engagement — to deny the high-speed avenues and force 13th Mech Division into a premature forward passage of lines at PL3.
hhq.endstate: FRIENDLY: OTG in a coherent area defence along PL4, reserves reconstituted. ENEMY: 13th Mech Div blocked forward of PL4, echelons intermixed; 14 ARMD DIV drawn into EA "HETMAN". TERRAIN: key terrain along PL4 retained; EA "HETMAN" shaped by obstacles and fires.
hhq.tasks: From D-Day, delay 13th Enemy Division within the AO from PL1 to PL4 and block it forward of PL4, IN ORDER TO enable the reaction force ("HETMAN") to counterattack and defeat 14 ARMD DIV.
hhq.newInfo:
• XI ASSAULT BDE holds the northern sector (opposite Z12) — OTG second effort.
• XII ARMD BDE is OTG NRES-1 — CATK from the SOUTH in step III-S1.
• BRC II "KHARAKTERNYK" is OPCON for Phase I only, then reverts to the OSG.
• Planning Annexes A–D (Fires, MILENG, Force ratios & ground, UAS) issued SEP26.

s13.mission: "SIRKO" disrupts and delays 13 MECH DIV from PL1 to PL4 and defends to PL GREEN, in order to allow the OSG striking force to destroy 14 ARMD DIV in EA "HETMAN".
s13.intent: PURPOSE: canalise the enemy into an engagement area forward of PL4 to set the conditions for "HETMAN" to counterattack. KEY TO SUCCESS: force 13th Div into a premature internal passage of lines forward of PL3. KEY TASKS: retain key terrain along PL4; canalise into the EA forward of PL4; alternate BAIDA's canalising defence with KOZHUMIAKA's local CATKs; preserve combat power to reconstitute task groups.
s13.specified:
• Delay 13 MECH DIV PL1 → PL4; block forward of PL4.
• UAS groups TERRA and FATUM in continuous acquisition over the eastern approach.
• BAIDA holds the southern corridor and blocks the northern flank of EA1 (II-S2); DOVBUSH screens and delays in the north.
• Execute obstacle belts on order.
s13.implied:
• Plan smoke per step (build-up vs sustainment rounds).
• Engineer survivability priority to the urban-belt battalions and the Artillery Group.
• Rear-area security on the Kramatorsk–Druzhkivka corridor.
• Route reconnaissance before every displacement; ASR/MSR maintenance.
• CIMIC: civil movement control on the MSR; coordinated evacuation.
s13.essential:
• Retain hill 247 as the PL4 anchor.
• Canalise the enemy ME into the southern corridor and fix it in EA1.
• Execute obstacle belts on order; prepare but do NOT fire secondary-crossing demolitions until the rearward passage is complete.
s13.constraints:
• KOTYHOROSHKO cannot displace without OTG motor transport (24 trucks in DS; 1 h 30 – 2 h reaction).
• XII ARMD BDE CATK crosses the brigade sector from the SOUTH — passage-of-lines control measures mandatory.
• BRC II OPCON for Phase I only.
• All displacements by night or under smoke.
• Every EW window deconflicted with the UAS plan.
s13.restraints:
• No decisive engagement forward of PL4.
• No fires beyond the CFSL without OTG clearance.
• No fires into the urban belt without OTG clearance (NFA).
• No anti-personnel mines.
s13.deductions:
• Hill 247 = decisive point; GO/NO-GO: if lost before D+3 the delay plan is invalid.
• The canal performs the shaping: enemy reduced to a few crossings = the engagement areas.
• Frontage: brigade holds ≈1.8 × its doctrinal frontage — strong points, EA defence, gaps covered by fire.
• Rasputitsa: wheels road-bound; branch required for +50 % movement times.

est.text: The enemy attacks on 15–25 % of SIRKO's frontage: local ratio 11.4:1 at PL1 and 7.5:1 at PL4 — above his own 6:1 breakthrough norm. DAG (36 × 2S19 + 18 MLRS) masses on Z11. PIR-4 can only be answered by OTG assets.
The brigade holds ≈1.8 × its doctrinal frontage in every phase (32.2 km on PL1, 21.2 km on PL4). Delay is the only posture available; it imposes 11.5 km/day on an enemy planning 40–60 km/day.

The four EFSTs need ≈1,590 × 152 mm rds against 600 ready (265 %). EFST-3 alone (≈960) exceeds the ready load; the autonomous window closes ≈H+72, exactly when EFST-3 begins. Assumption A6 is load-bearing.

6,000 mines = 9.6 obstacle groups; one continuous belt across PL4 would need 10,600. No belt can be continuous. One breach lane per night → one supported CATK axis at a time. RD-1 is a single point of failure for DC-B4.
FPV requirement ≈1,500 airframes vs 890 held (shortfall 41 %); organic stock runs dry ≈H+48. Interceptors: 48 kills for the whole operation. Degraded-UAS branch required (Annex D).
AD Bn + OTG SHORAD Bty cover the Artillery Group and the PL4 anchor simultaneously; nothing above 6 km (glide bombs are a theatre problem).
OTG EW Group jams one axis per phase; own jamming blinds own FPV in the same window. EMCON at every step transition.
Log Bn sustains 3 combat days at 60 t/day; the operation runs 5–6. 152 mm ammunition alone (≈69 t) exceeds one day of lift. Ammunition pre-positioned at BP2 and BP4.
Role 1 CASEVAC 45 min; evacuation axis to the Kramatorsk–Druzhkivka rear. Combat power reported as % of initial strength (FFIR-1 < 70 %).

inputs.cpg:
• Wargame COA 1 against ECOA-1 (MLCOA); test ECOA-2 (MDCOA) as a branch at the enemy DP-1 and DP-3.
• Combine techniques: key events for Phase I, belt method for II-S1/II-S2, avenue-in-depth for III–IV (and V if time allows).
• Adjudicate on the frontage-corrected ratios of Planning Annex C — brigade-against-brigade is the wrong comparison.
• Express combat power as % of initial strength; any battalion below 70 % triggers FFIR-1.
• Do not overstate the effectiveness of indirect fires or friendly weapons; do not fight subordinates' fights.

coas.name: COA 1 — Delay in successive positions with local CATKs
coas.stmt: Delay PL1→PL4 alternating BAIDA's canalising defence with KOZHUMIAKA's local counterattacks in each EA; XII ARMD BDE CATK from the SOUTH in III-S1; feints IVO EA2/EA3; area defence on PL4 anchored on hill 247; CATK in EA7 in support of the OSG strike.

t1.a: BRC II "KHARAKTERNYK" screens BHL–PL1. KOTYHOROSHKO (ME) guards the first line; 24 OTG trucks in DS at the loading area IVO BP2 (move NLT H-2). BAIDA protects the BRC II passage in the south; DOVBUSH secures the north. KOZHUMIAKA at BP1, BPT CATK in EA1. OB-1 groups emplaced on the southern canal crossings.

eng.label: Guard the first line · BRC II rearward passage

t2.a: KOTYHOROSHKO withdraws by OTG lift to BP2 under fog / darkness; trucks released to the OTG. BAIDA and DOVBUSH set on PL1. Bde Arty Gp fires AMA 1 on the lead battalion in march column.

eng.label: Set on PL1 · AMA 1 on the march column

t3.a: BAIDA (ME) fixes the enemy in EA1: A Coy forward, AT sect on the gaps, mortars and AMA 1 on the EA. DOVBUSH delays to PL YELLOW. XV/2 + OTG UAS Coy 3 in DS. Interceptor teams pushed to the BAIDA fixing position.

t4.a: KOZHUMIAKA (ME) counterattacks from BP1 into EA1. BAIDA blocks the northern flank of EA1 (OB-2). DOVBUSH delays PL YELLOW → PL3. EFST-1: neutralise ≥ 2 of 3 platoons of the lead company for the duration of the CATK.

t5.a: Engineer Bn completes OB-4 (3 groups, 1,875 mines) on the PL4 anchor and the entries to EA4/EA5 NLT H+72. Survivability priority: Arty Gp firing positions, then BAIDA on hill 247. RD-1 held at STATE 1 until XII ARMD BDE reports clear of PL PURPLE.

eng.label: PL4 anchor — hill 247 and the canal (OB-4)

t6.a: BAIDA (ME) and DOVBUSH contain the enemy IVO PL3 and withdraw O/O to PL PURPLE. KOZHUMIAKA BPT CATK from BP3. XII ARMD BDE (OTG NRES-1) counterattacks from the SOUTH through the RFA; XV/2 + UAS Coy 3 in DS.

eng.label: Contain IVO PL3 and withdraw to PL PURPLE
XII ARMD BDE CATK from the SOUTH (DC-B4)

t7.a: BAIDA supports by fire KOZHUMIAKA's movement; KOZHUMIAKA feints IVO EA3; KOTYHOROSHKO feints IVO EA2 (OTG lift on call; break clean NLT H+66). Deception: simulated CP traffic in the north.

eng.label: Feint IVO EA3 · support by fire

t8.a: BAIDA (ME) blocks enemy forward units at PL4; DOVBUSH canalises to EA4; KOTYHOROSHKO BPT BP4; KOZHUMIAKA BPT CATK from BP5 into EA5. EFST-3: suppress the lead company in each of EA4–EA7.

t9.a: KOZHUMIAKA (ME) counterattacks in EA7; BAIDA canalises to EA7; DOVBUSH canalises to EA6 and protects the northern flank; KOTYHOROSHKO BPT reinforce EA6, O/O consolidates EA7. XV/2 + UAS Coy 3 in DS.

eng.label: DOVBUSH canalises to EA6 · flank protection

coas.name: COA 2 — (to be developed by the syndicate)

ecoas.name: ECOA-1 — Early penetration (MLCOA)
ecoas.text: MR BDE 1 (BMP) attacks in Z11 as divisional ME with its organic 41-tank bn; the Tank Brigade echeloned behind as divisional reserve. MR BDE 2 (BTR) supports in Z12 with MR BDE 3 echeloned in depth. Internal FPOL at Red Line 2 (DP-1); 14 ARMD DIV FPOL IVO Kramatorsk (DP-2) → Kharkiv NLT D+5.

bySector.Z11: Step 1: MR BDE 1 (BMP) ME + Tank Bde behind. Step 2: Tank Bde committed to exploit.
bySector.Z12: Step 1: MR BDE 2 (BTR) fixes and widens; MR BDE 3 in depth. Step 2: MR BDE 3 passes forward.

t1.r: Div 13 recon battalions probe both corridors; Orlan-10 and Forpost scan for the forward edge and the BP2 loading area. MR BDE 1 (BMP) advance guard closes on the BHL in Z11. DAG preparation compressed towards 15 min.

t2.r: MR BDE 1 (BMP) deploys two battalions from march column forward of PL1. Lancet-3 hunts the truck column (2.5 km at 100 m spacing). R-330B jamming over Z11.

t3.r: MR BDE 1 attacks with two battalions forward on company frontages; its organic tank battalion (41 MBT) is committed into EA1. Artillery shifts onto the forward companies; the EW Coy contests FPV links from H-hour.

t4.r: Div 13 commits its second-line brigade through MR BDE 1 at PL YELLOW (enemy DP-1 on Red Line 2). The Tank Brigade moves forward as divisional reserve. DAG switches to counter-battery against the Bde Arty Gp.

t5.r: MR BDE 1 engineer battalion brings TMM-3 and PP-91 to the canal; 4–6 lanes observed (enemy ME indicator). DAG masses on hill 247.

t6.r: Deliberate attack against PL3 after full preparation; the Tank Brigade (divisional reserve) is committed to exploit. Lancet and FPV on the passage-of-lines corridor.

t7.r: The enemy commits against EA2/EA3 (deception taken). Shahed-136 strikes on the MSR and the Kramatorsk–Druzhkivka hub.

t8.r: Narrow-front mass attack (6–10 km, two brigades forward) against PL4. 14 ARMD DIV approaches IVO Kramatorsk (enemy DP-2).

t9.r: 14 ARMD DIV conducts its forward passage of lines through Div 13 and enters EA "HETMAN". Div 13 remnants attempt to envelop the CATK through EA6.

ecoas.name: ECOA-2 — Fix, then strike (MDCOA)
ecoas.text: Simultaneous commitment of Divs 11–13 at Red Line 1; MR BDE 2 and 3 (BTR) attack on a broad front to fix; MR BDE 1 (BMP) + Tank Bde held as a single striking force. IND BDE 21/22 released early at Red Line 2 (DP-3). Step 2 and Phase 2 compressed — 14 ARMD DIV follows the assault echelon directly.

bySector.Z11: Step 1: MR BDE 3 (BTR) first line to fix. Step 2: MR BDE 1 + Tank Bde committed together as striking force.
bySector.Z12: Step 1: MR BDE 2 (BTR) on a broad front to fix. Step 2: continues to fix; Tank Bde waits behind Z12.

t1.r: Divisions 11, 12 and 13 attack simultaneously; MR BDE 3 (BTR) leads in Z11 to fix while MR BDE 1 and the Tank Bde are held back. The main effort is not identifiable before D+1.

t2.r: Divisions 11, 12 and 13 attack simultaneously; MR BDE 3 (BTR) leads in Z11 to fix while MR BDE 1 and the Tank Bde are held back. The main effort is not identifiable before D+1.

t3.r: MR BDE 3 (BTR) attacks to fix and dismounts short of EA1; the BMP brigade and the Tank Brigade stay back as the divisional striking force.

t4.r: MR BDE 1 and the Tank Brigade are committed together as the divisional striking force; IND BDE 21/22 released early (enemy DP-3).

t5.r: Compressed timeline: 14 ARMD DIV lead elements follow the assault echelon directly towards PL4.

t6.r: The striking force is already committed and IND BDE 21/22 secure the Z11 flank — the XII ARMD BDE CATK meets a secured flank.

t7.r: Compressed timeline: 14 ARMD DIV lead elements follow the assault echelon directly towards PL4.

t8.r: Div 13 and 14 ARMD DIV lead elements strike PL4 at the same time (assumption A4 fails).

t9.r: 14 ARMD DIV is already intermixed with Div 13 forward of PL4 — EA "HETMAN" is less clearly defined.

ces.title: Battle handover at PL1 and BRC II rearward passage

r.ECOA-1: Div 13 recon battalions probe both corridors; Orlan-10 / Forpost look for the forward edge and the BP2 loading area. MR BDE 1 (BMP) closes on the BHL in Z11 as divisional ME. DAG preparation compressed towards 15 min.
r.ECOA-2: Divisions 11, 12 and 13 attack simultaneously; MR BDE 3 (BTR) leads in Z11 to fix while MR BDE 1 and the Tank Bde are held back. The main effort is not identifiable before D+1.

ces.cr: X1 obscurant over the handover points; Bde EW Coy against UAS control links; X2 counter-fire (XV/1 + radars) on the DAG. PIR-1 answered from hill 247 and by UAS; DC-B1 clock started.

ces.title: Fix the enemy lead echelon in EA1

r.ECOA-1: MR BDE 1 attacks with two battalions forward on company frontages; its organic tank battalion (41 MBT) is committed into EA1. Artillery shifts onto the forward companies.
r.ECOA-2: MR BDE 3 (BTR) attacks to fix and dismounts short of EA1; the BMP brigade and the Tank Brigade stay back as the divisional striking force.

ces.cr: HPT-1: massed fires (AMA 1) + ATGM + FPV on the tank battalion inside the kill zone. BAIDA breaks clean under X1 obscurant NLT H+10.

ces.title: KOZHUMIAKA CATK and enemy internal passage of lines

r.ECOA-1: The second-line brigade passes through MR BDE 1 at PL YELLOW (enemy DP-1 on Red Line 2); the Tank Brigade moves forward as divisional reserve.
r.ECOA-2: MR BDE 1 and the Tank Brigade are committed together as the divisional striking force; IND BDE 21/22 released early (enemy DP-3).

ces.cr: X5 on C2/EW nodes during the passage; KOZHUMIAKA disengages above 70 % combat power; XII ARMD BDE warned (DP-B2).

ces.title: XII ARMD BDE CATK from the SOUTH and rearward passage

r.ECOA-1: Deliberate attack against PL3 after full preparation; the Tank Brigade exploits the gap.
r.ECOA-2: The striking force is already committed and IND BDE 21/22 secure the Z11 flank — the XII ARMD BDE CATK meets a secured flank.

ces.cr: RFA / RFL in force, contact points and guides manned; RD-1 fired only on the Brigade Commander's order after the last XII ARMD BDE vehicle is clear.

ces.title: Anchor on PL4 — deception, feints EA2/EA3, canal

r.ECOA-1: The enemy commits against EA2/EA3 (deception taken); engineer effort concentrated on the canal crossings.
r.ECOA-2: Compressed timeline: 14 ARMD DIV lead elements follow the assault echelon directly towards PL4.

ces.cr: EFST-2 on the lead-battalion C2 node; KOTYHOROSHKO clear of contact NLT H+66; OB-4 complete NLT H+72; HPT-3 on the crossing means.

ces.title: Area defence PL4 → PL GREEN

r.ECOA-1: Narrow-front mass attack (6–10 km, two brigades forward) against PL4; 14 ARMD DIV approaches IVO Kramatorsk.
r.ECOA-2: Div 13 and 14 ARMD DIV lead elements strike PL4 at the same time (assumption A4 fails).

ces.cr: EFST-3 on EA4–EA7 (≈960 rds); SHORAD over PL4; withdrawal behind PL GREEN with CP ≥ 60 %.

ces.title: CATK into EA7 and support to the OSG strike

r.ECOA-1: 14 ARMD DIV conducts its FPOL through Div 13 and enters EA "HETMAN".
r.ECOA-2: 14 ARMD DIV is already intermixed with Div 13 forward of PL4 — EA "HETMAN" is less clearly defined.

ces.cr: KOZHUMIAKA CATK in EA7; KOTYHOROSHKO consolidates; FPOL corridors open, marked and guided for the OSG striking force.

assumptions.text: OSG "HETMAN" keeps its striking force intact until Phase V.
assumptions.fail: Phase V has no strike to support; the brigade fights a straight area defence on PL5.

assumptions.text: Air superiority remains contested; the main threat is FPV/UAS and artillery, not manned aircraft.
assumptions.fail: AD priorities and the whole movement plan change.

assumptions.text: Crossings between PL1 and PL4 stay trafficable until the planned demolitions.
assumptions.fail: Withdrawal timings collapse; the delay cannot be sustained.

assumptions.text: 14 ARMD DIV commits as second echelon after 13 MECH DIV is attrited, not simultaneously.
assumptions.fail: The brigade faces two divisions at once; PL4 is not holdable.

assumptions.text: XII ARMD BDE is available for the counterattack from the SOUTH in step III-S1.
assumptions.fail: DC-B4 cannot be achieved; the brigade must hold PL PURPLE unaided.

assumptions.text: Artillery and mortar resupply sustains the rotating priority of fires.
assumptions.fail: EFST-3 fails and with it DC-B6; the III-S2 feints lose credibility.

assumptions.text: The 24 OTG trucks stay in direct support of KOTYHOROSHKO throughout.
assumptions.fail: The reserve is immobile; every KOTYHOROSHKO task becomes static.

t1.cr: X1 obscurant over the handover points; Bde EW Coy against UAS control links; X2 counter-fire (XV/1 + radars) on the DAG. Interceptors and mobile fire groups over the loading area. PIR-1 answered from hill 247 and by UAS; DC-B1 clock started.
t1.rem: Handover complete; main axis confirmed SOUTH.
t1.branch: If the handover is caught in the open, BAIDA fights forward of PL1 and the delay starts short.

t2.cr: Mobile fire groups escort the column; EW windows deconflicted with the UAS plan. BRC II rearward passage complete. DC-B1 reported: ≥ 2 enemy first-echelon bns deploying forward of PL1.
t2.rem: Truck column is the most lucrative target in the sector.
t2.branch: If trucks are hit, KOTYHOROSHKO occupies BP2 dismounted with a 2 h delay.

t3.cr: HPT-1: massed fires and ATGM on the tank battalion inside the kill zone. BAIDA breaks clean under X1 obscurant NLT H+10. Arbiter adjudicates on the frontage-corrected ratio (Annex C: 11.4:1 at PL1).
t3.rem: DC-B2: enemy held in EA1 ≥ 2 h; lead bn attrited ≥ 30 %.
t3.branch: If the enemy bypasses EA1 to the south, B Coy blocks and the KOZHUMIAKA CATK shifts one EA south.

t4.cr: EW desynchronises enemy C2 during the passage; X5 on C2/EW nodes. KOZHUMIAKA disengages and recovers without decisive engagement; XII ARMD BDE warned (DP-B2). PIR-2 and PIR-5 answered.
t4.rem: DC-B3: 2nd-echelon brigade moving through the first echelon forward of PL3.
t4.branch: If KOZHUMIAKA falls below 70 % (FFIR-1), XII ARMD BDE CATK is brought forward.

t5.cr: HPT-3: crossing means struck while committed (FPV + Bde Arty Gp). MOD re-closes a breached lane in 12 min. OP on hill 247 keeps PIR-1 answered without UAS.
t5.rem: Barrier budget is binding: no continuous belt possible (Annex B).
t5.branch: If hill 247 is lost before D+3, inform the OTG (GO/NO-GO).

t6.cr: RFA / RFL in force; contact points and guides manned. XII ARMD BDE disrupts the enemy passage and passes rearward; RD-1 fired only on the Brigade Commander's order after the last vehicle is clear.
t6.rem: DC-B4: XII ARMD BDE clear of PL PURPLE without fratricide.
t6.branch: If A5 fails (XII ARMD BDE not available), the brigade holds PL PURPLE unaided.

t7.cr: Mobile fire groups march with the KOTYHOROSHKO column; interceptors bound ahead. EFST-2: neutralise the 2nd-echelon brigade's lead-bn C2 node in EA2/EA3 for ≥ 2 h (≈270 rds).
t7.rem: Organic FPV stock runs dry ≈H+48 (Annex D).
t7.branch: Degraded-UAS branch: anti-armour effect reverts to line-of-sight weapons inside the EAs.

t8.cr: EA4/EA5 engaged by the Bde Arty Gp; SHORAD Bty over PL4. EFST-3 needs ≈960 rds — exceeds the ready load. Brigade withdraws behind PL GREEN in good order.
t8.rem: DC-B6: PL4 held ≥ 12 h; brigade CP ≥ 60 %.
t8.branch: If A6 fails, EFST-3 fails and with it DC-B6.

t9.cr: OSG striking force crosses the LD; FPOL corridors open, marked and guided. KOZHUMIAKA hands EA7 to KOTYHOROSHKO. PIR-4 reported to the OSG.
t9.rem: DC-B7 achieved. Reconstitution behind PL5 is a task, not part of the DC.
t9.branch: If KOZHUMIAKA is enveloped through EA6, DOVBUSH blocks and KOTYHOROSHKO reinforces.
